guarantee: check-absent, put, full read-back by SHA-256 and size, serialized by one local writer (an exclusive lock per uploader). Detects pre-existing different bytes before writing and corrupt bytes after writing. Not an atomic create: wrangler r2 object put has no conditional-create option, so a concurrent foreign writer between the check and the put cannot be ruled out.
